lines: Every place has the same sidebar, with Hide and Expand, and a tab remembers where you were.
Chat shows one working indicator and a shorter message menu, and tells you when someone is typing.
Connect a service from one card in the chat: paste the key, and Vyre says where it is sent and keeps it in your Vault.
Getting started's How you work is a talk with the Assistant, and what it learns is a list you can edit.
Drive and OneDrive files open in Vyre's own viewers, and your edits go back to where the file lives.
Delete an agent for good. A goal says why a check-in could not run. The Inbox keeps each conversation's own drafts.
